periods.time: Night after the Seven Stars award ceremony

name.zh: 黑骑士测试与魔人真相
name.en: Black Knight Test and Desperado Revelation

periods.summary: Ascaride ambushes Ikki and Stella at the empty Bay Dome to test their strength, forcing them to fight together against his Orichalcos armor before Kurono stops the match. Tsukikage then explains that Ikki's second Ittou Shura in the Seven Stars final was a Desperado awakening, placing him outside normal fate and allowing future growth beyond fixed magic limits.
periods.cause: Tsukikage summons Ikki and Stella to reveal information; Ascaride insists on seeing their strength and is allowed to attack under supervision.
periods.process: Ikki detects an unseen presence behind Stella, Ascaride attacks, Stella's Calusaritio Salamander fails to stop him, and Ikki uses Dokuga no Tachi and cooperation with Stella through a combined charge. Before Ikki and Stella activate their strongest powers, Kurono, Nene, and Tsukikage intervene. Tsukikage explains the Desperado realm and the League's secrecy around it.
periods.outcome: Ikki learns he is a newly awakened Desperado and is asked not to reveal the truth publicly; Ascaride departs after his test.
periods.significance: Introduces the Desperado concept, reframes Ikki's final victory, and connects local tournament events to world-level powers.
